name: mirage
text: Done in code: with the GitHub engine driving, the phone no longer runs any Kalshi scan; it only reads the engine's Kalshi list (and says so on screen if the engine isn't answering). The other session's release (v1.0.50) is building right now, so I'm waiting for it to finish before I ship mine as v1.0.51, to avoid colliding. One note: the engine's Kalshi mode (Kalshi > Setup) has to be PAPER or LIVE for the engine to scan Kalshi; yours is LIVE now.
